text:
morgan: Heads-up — I'm stopping the EU canary (12%) for the text-gen endpoint. Seeing embed error rate jump and a ~12% token inflation after the tokenizer change. Pausing traffic now. @deploy-bot can you pin eu-west-1 to model 'redwood-text-4.2.0'? Change window open until 22:00 UTC, requesting ops sign-off for rollback window.

deploy-bot: <deploy-bot> received pin request. initiating...
```http
POST /api/v1/rollouts/pin
{
  "model": "redwood-text-4.2.0",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "reason": "embed regression + token inflation",
  "requested_by": "morgan"
}
-> accepted id: roll-4321
```
sanjay: How bad is the embed regression? Is it general or specific to html payloads? telemetry shows a crawler spike earlier.
morgan: On A/B eval set embed cosine dropped ~8% on affected traffic. Token count went up ~12% for sessions with HTML blobs — looks like sanitizer/tokenizer interaction expanding whitespace/escape sequences. Risk: higher cost + degraded results.
emma: Agree pause. @lauren can infra quickly confirm whether the spike is dominated by helper services sending HTML? If so we can scope mitigation.
lauren: Running quick query now: `select count(*) from requests where region='eu-west-1' and model like '%4.3%' and content_type='text/html' and ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'` -> 842 rows (baseline ~41). Definitely a concentrated spike.
deploy-bot: Pin completed: roll-4321 -> model: redwood-text-4.2.0 pinned in eu-west-1 until 2026-03-23T22:30:00Z. Traffic diverted. Canary stopped: 12% -> 0%. Emit: `pin_status: success`, `rollback-needed: false`.
sanjay: Good. Can we also bump a targeted eval against html-heavy prompt set and compute cost delta? Need that for the PM update.
morgan: I'll trigger the eval and open an incident. Plan: keep pin for 60m, run targeted eval and live QA on html-heavy requests. If metrics recover, resume at 5% then step to 15%. If regression persists, full rollback to previous release. @emma ack?
emma: :thumbsup: ack. Please include estimated cost delta and short release-note blurb mentioning tokenizer change + revert plan. PMs should notify customers in affected cohort.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-20260323-17. Owner: morgan. Channel: #incidents. Pager: infra on-call.
morgan: Adding release-note draft to the release branch and will DM PMs. I'll update this thread once the eval completes (~15m).
